Explanation: The application dynamically generates a title header where the number of dashes above and below the title matches the length of 'Disneyland Review Analyser' using '-' * len(title).
The dataset is loaded into a list structure using the load_data() function in main.py, and the total number of records read is displayed to confirm successful loading.
The main menu is displayed with the correct options and formatting by calling display_main_menu() from tui.py, ensuring separation between user interface and control logic.
Conditional logic validates menu selections, confirming valid choices or displaying an error message for invalid input.
A while True loop in main.py controls execution, allowing continuous interaction until exit while preventing repeated title and data loading.
Submenu options are presented dynamically through functions in tui.py, enabling navigation between viewing, visualisation, exporting, or exiting.
Reviews are filtered by park name using get_reviews_by_park() in process.py after collecting user input via the TUI.
Review counts for specific parks and reviewer locations are calculated using get_review_count_by_park_location().
Average review scores per park and year are calculated using get_average_score_per_year_by_park() and displayed to the user.
A pie chart showing review distribution per park is generated using matplotlib via plot_most_reviewed_parks().
A bar chart displaying average review scores per park is produced using plot_average_scores_per_park().
Top reviewer locations for a selected park are visualised using plot_top_locations_by_park().
Average ratings by month for a selected park are displayed using plot_average_rating_by_month().
Average scores per park by reviewer location are aggregated and displayed without additional user input.
An exporter module with a DataExporter class enables exporting summary data to TXT, CSV, and JSON formats, supported by an export menu and class diagram.
